scope: Current filesystem locations for preserved Grok originals; historical source paths and frozen receipts remain unchanged.
resolution_rule: Match an exact file path or a directory prefix followed by slash; append the unchanged suffix to current_path. Validate the file SHA before use. Pending mappings are not live.
incoming_policy: From Grok is the incoming drop area. After extraction/integrity verification, root moves retained source remnants to Processed; project review/production copies remain the app inputs. ZIP cleanup requires its own verified receipt and authorization.

runtime_catalog_check.basis: Every local catalog src/thumb resolved from the visual_library directory using extended Windows filesystem I/O.
